FILE: tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1929LiteralIQCarrierActual.lean
LEAN SHA256: d4bcc68b50f8812d26f9039cdd3591830099acd089959b554ab745e02f943cd7
OLEAN: .lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1929LiteralIQCarrierActual.olean
OLEAN SHA256: 2073a08980db517e35b055dda96929bdd62d06ec7ad55786c67e4ce8bf6ea7b1
AXIOMS: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only (checked by #print axioms).

MATHEMATICAL RESULT
- Constructed the literal completion carrier
  LiteralCompletionIQCarrier T = (b : Bad (nativePlaceSelection T)) -> rootBase T b
  and the actual canonical Q-linear embedding
  completionToRootExtension T : LiteralCompletionIQCarrier T -> S1902Carrier T,
  coordinatewise algebraMap K_b -> K_b(root_b). It is injective, and its image
  completionIQSubcarrier T is a proper Q-submodule of the S1902 carrier.
- At the positive theta label j=1 (gaussExponent 1 = 1), the S1902 theta image is
  exactly the root family b |-> root_b. Proved it is NOT in the completion image
  (thetaImage_not_mem_completionRange), so the canonical map is not surjective and
  the whole S1902 image set is not contained in the completion subcarrier
  (thetaImageSet_not_subset_completionIQSubcarrier). The actual S1902
  IQHullLogVolumeInterface.imageSet is likewise not contained in it.
- Defined the realization surface LiteralIQCarrierRealization: a completion IQ hull
  interface, a completion theta image satisfying the paper root equation, and an
  identification map to S1902 equal to the canonical embedding and carrying the
  theta image to the S1902 theta image. Proved it has no inhabitant, both from the
  root equation and independently from the theta-image compatibility.

EXACT FIRST MISSING
LiteralCompletionRootMissing T := for every bad place b, a nonzero completion
element r_b with r_b^(2l) = qVFamily T b. Proved equivalent to S342's
TwoLthRootData (completionRootDatum_iff_twoLthRootData) and impossible by
twoLthRootData_impossible. Thus the completion-valued literal IQ carrier cannot
be identified with the S1902 root-extension carrier while preserving the actual
theta image: this is an S342-type completion-root obstruction, not a missing
analytic/Kummer input. The paper K-side q_v/root remains a separate source object
(S424 PaperKvQRootData), not the repo qVFamily.

Key declarations for consumers:
  LiteralCompletionIQCarrier, completionToRootExtension,
  completionToRootExtension_injective, completionToRootExtension_not_surjective,
  completionIQSubcarrier, completionIQSubcarrier_ne_top,
  completionRootDatum_iff_twoLthRootData, completionRootDatum_impossible,
  thetaImage_not_mem_completionRange,
  thetaImageSet_not_subset_completionIQSubcarrier,
  s1902IQHullLogVolumeInterface_imageSet_not_subset_completionIQSubcarrier,
  LiteralIQCarrierRealization, literalIQCarrierRealization_impossible,
  LiteralCompletionRootMissing, literalCompletionRootMissing_impossible,
  literalIQCarrierRealization_implies_rootMissing.

Compile queue appended; AUDIT_LEDGER.md updated with the SHA/EXIT/olean and
result. Probe files were removed.
